title: Birthday Probability
hook: What if you bet on a shared birthday?
script: What if you bet on a shared birthday? In a room of just 23 people, there's a better than even chance two share a birthday. It's based on complementary probability. The math only needs a couple of dozen because it counts every possible pair. Your intuition says hundreds, but 23 is enough.
